top_signals.title: AI Fears Return With Data Center IPO Flop; SpaceX, Netflix Earnings
top_signals.summary: US equity futures slip, pausing an AI recovery in stocks, after South Korean data center company Elice plunged in its trading debut. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy heads to Norway for fresh peace talks as tensions with the US deepens. SpaceX, Netflix, General Motors, RTX, and Northrop are set to report earnings. Jeanne Sun of Citigroup Global Markets joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss her outlook for this earnings season.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: European Gas Prices Rise Above €90 for First Time Since 2022
top_signals.summary: European natural gas climbed above €90 for the first time in almost four years, raising the threat of a renewed energy crunch as Europe heads into the peak winter heating season.

top_signals.title: AI giant Perplexity taps London startup Valarian in sovereign tech drive
top_signals.summary: US AI giant Perplexity has struck a deal with London-based startup Valarian to bring its technology into the UK government and defence systems, a major boost to Britain’s ambition to reduce its reliance on foreign tech infrastructure.
